newsitem.title: CHINA: Shanghai coal in over-supply in first half - paper.
newsitem.headline: Shanghai coal in over-supply in first half - paper.

text.p: Coal was in over-supply in Shanghai in the first half of 1997 amid fierce competition among coal suppliers fuelled by a fall in demand because some local industrial enterprises have closed and others have cut production, Business News said on Tuesday.

Coal sales by the Shanghai Fuel Co, a coal supplier accounting for 63 percent of the local market, fell a year-on-year 33 percent in the first half of 1997, to 2.458 million tonnes, the newspaper said.
Industrial coal demand fell 30 percent amid some closures and output cuts, it said, citing the textile industry as an example.
Coal demand from textile enterprises in Shanghai fell a year-on-year 57.6 percent in first-half 1997, it said.
